text:
jamie (release): Heads-up — planning a canary for microgarden tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner. Target cohorts: US-West first. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~45m. Any blockers?

alex (eng): I can own the deploy. I'll be on the window. No infra changes on my side. Do we have the feature flag key and route name?

jamie (release): Flag is ff.microgarden.v1 (toggle via console API). Route name will be /models/microgarden:1.0 — we'll shift route weights.

sam (sre): I'll own smoke. Monitoring checklist: 95th latency, 5xx rate, request success %, model token errors. Alerts to set: >3% 5xx sustained over 5m, 2x baseline 95th latency. Also verify autoscale stability during ramp.

priya (pm): Cohort selection proposal: start US-West 1%, then expand to US-East and EU-C in wave 2. Full 20% target for day-one ramp. Also want small internal beta audience for repros.

taylor (infra): No DB migrations, confirmed. Watch dedicated GPU pool usage — Dedicated capacity has room but keep an eye for pod churn.

alex (eng): Deploy steps (short):
1) push image to registry
2) create rollout: set model route weight to 1% for microgarden:1.0
3) flip feature flag
4) run smoke suite
Rollback = revert route weight + flip flag off.
Snippet to flip flag:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags/ff.microgarden.v1/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"enabled": true}'
```

sam (sre): Smoke checklist (short):
- run synthetic prompt set (https://internal/redwood/smoke/microgarden)
- `scripts/smoke.sh microgarden`
- check 95th < 300ms, error < 0.5%, 5xx < 0.3%
- watch model-token-error metric and request timeouts
I'll post results and a pass/fail summary in this thread.

jamie (release): Rollback plan: immediate revert of route weights + flip flag off. If thresholds breached during any stage, rollback to previous model and abort ramp. Alex can perform emergency rollback within 5m.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by jamie for 2026-05-10T17:00:00Z (1777778888).

priya (pm): Can we tag the first cohort with audience=internal_beta? That helps engineering reproduce user flows.

alex (eng): Added audience=internal_beta to the 1% cohort. Will annotate rollout notes and changelog.

sam (sre): I'll create an incident channel and add ops-oncall if thresholds breach. Also enabling cost anomaly monitor for token usage during the ramp.

taylor (infra): +1 on standby engineer for scaling issues. I'll keep infra pager ready.

jamie (release): Final checklist: Alex (deploy), Sam (smoke), Taylor (infra standby), Priya (cohort signoff). Please ack.

alex (eng): ack :thumbsup:

sam (sre): ack

taylor (infra): ack

priya (pm): ack — looks good to me.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled in 1h: canary deploy for microgarden (1777778888).
